notes.title: 《Three Kingdoms Heroes》Update Preview
notes.notes:
Expected to be updated on October 1st, the main content includes shortcut keys, maps, and all the contents of the weekly schedule, with the addition of chapters 9 and 10



I am currently translating the English version of the following chapters, and it is expected to be available on October 1st. I apologize for the delay

                                                                                                                                                ——qingyi



Subsequent content:

1.Add Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 to the weekly schedule, with a complete ending

2.New forging table, map and other shortcut keys have been added to optimize and enhance the related experience

3.Enhance the strength of most characters and make the content game simpler

4.Cancel all rewards for difficulty levels, no longer force players to challenge high difficulty levels, and allow them to play at any difficulty level as they please

...

A more detailed version update announcement will be written at that time

notes.title: 0425 update
notes.notes:
【The game opens slowly】
Steam Settings - Download - Auto Shader Selection Off

【Main Repair】
Fixed after the last adaptation of the controller. Causing some keyboard washout players to experience keyboard failure or drift at certain times,
This time it is also compatible with the keyboard, wasd can be used normally and pagination will also take effect,
There was no feedback in the short term, so I thought there was no problem. Everyone can discuss it in the discussion group or update the announcement.
(I don't want to say that I optimized a certain operation and it actually affected players on the other side)


【Regarding the default recommended equipment for the system】
I strongly advise against using [Recommended Equipment]
It only selects equipment with high numerical values (which may be slightly useful in the early stages, but is generally incorrect in the later stages), and does not choose mechanisms. It is far less powerful than your own combination.
Try different combinations of equipment, and you will find new world.

【Regarding Dialogue】
Some players have reported skipping in the conversation. I want to say that he doesn't have it. If you carefully compare it, you can find that the preface is accompanied by the postscript,
Just after accelerating, he will jump a bit, appearing as if he has jumped a line, which does not affect the normal progress of the plot.

【Regarding the Winning Method of Gomoku】
First hand oblique angle 12354
Players who really don't understand the small game of Gomoku can figure it out themselves
Some players have developed a 10 step winning strategy, which is basically the same.
Of course, you can also play Go with it through WeChat mini programs or similar platforms.


【Text Content Repair】
0. Optimized the issue where an NPC always blocks the path when walking at Zhang Fei Manor. Now he will stay there and walk back and forth without affecting the player's normal journey.
1. Fixed some initial year and year errors (writing the first year of Chuping, which is a bit outrageous. We will also pay attention to some historical year issues in the future and fix them together in the second weekly update)
2. Fixed the issue of incorrect ticket description given by Canglan Fantasy Realm
3. Fixed the issue where in special circumstances, if a player goes fishing after descending Changshan, they still cannot fish in Qinghe South
4. The previous update in Jizhou added that if you haven't found a destiny or Spring and Autumn formula in Changshan, you can buy it again at the Jizhou Treasure Store. The criterion is if you haven't bought it before.
5. Fixed a traffic issue north of Zhuojun
6. Slightly optimized the map at the Tree of the Underworld in Sizhou.
7. Bamboo shoot collection has been added to some maps.
8. Fixed a description error after Anping defeated the Yellow Turban
Thank you for your support. I can only say that Xu Rong and Dong Bai have already completed the second week's progress.

notes.title: 0421 update, Optimize the controller and supporting Win7 users to play
notes.notes:
If entering the game is slow, you need to turn off the shader. If you encounter cloud storage issues, simply log in to your account again. 
 [Win7 related] 
This theoretically fixes the issue of Win7 not being able to open games (the nw. js version has been changed to 0.68, which should be the most commonly used nw), and achievements can be correctly connected (Steam no longer supports Win7, so if you still can't play, we recommend upgrading your system)

 [Handle related] 
The controller has added a basic button adaptation, where A is for confirmation, B is for return and menu, and (the previous Y was too far away) LB is for enemy situation, LT RT is for flipping up and down pages, which has led to the situation where if the player does not actively adapt,
The default configuration of the controller is very difficult to use and not very intelligent. The menu keys have all changed to+signs. Now the overall operation logic is similar to that of keyboard and mouse, that is, return and menu are the same key
If you encounter any problems while playing with the controller, you can also contact me in the discussion group or Q group.
If the controller fails, you can consider placing the mouse inside the game interface (currently, it seems that the controller will fail when the mouse leaves the game interface)
Now you can see the operation prompts for the controller and keyboard in the picture book of Qianyuan Treasure Mirror, and the initial game also added the operation prompts for the controller

 [Plot freezes] 
Chapter 2 [Bright Day Fantasy] General Li, I found that some players have a probability of not being able to defeat the tigers in the Fantasy three times in a row and getting stuck (they have run out of tickets and are unwilling to read files or change difficulty levels)
When fighting against the White Sha Soul for the first time here, if you cannot defeat the Tiger, the game will end and you will no longer fly directly out of the illusion.
In this way, the game ends and your save will be sent to the underworld by your master. It's very close and won't cause this strange plot to get stuck.
By the way, we will increase the number of tickets provided by Mingtian Mirage from 3 to 5
Fishing related
The challenge store in Qian Yuanbaojian has added the sale of Sea King Fishing, where you can buy a 100 point challenge point (after the end of Chapter 2)
If you have been playing for a long time and forget about the fishing rod, you can still purchase fishing equipment here
The 100 challenge points in this version are still quite easy.
At present, it seems that I have descended from Changshan. If I had not purchased fishing gear and bait before, it would have made it impossible to fulfill the old man's request. Now, there is a new item store selling fishing gear and bait in Qinghe County after the war,
The task of becoming a fishing expert can definitely be completed.
And subsequently, prop stores in Dazhou have increased the sales of green bamboo poles and fishing baits. At Chenliu Props Store in Sizhou respectively
Xiangyang Props Store in Jingzhou Chaisang Props Store in Yangzhou Jiameng Pass Props Store in Yizhou.

 [Some Content Optimization] 
[Changshan] A small path has been added on the side of Changshan Mountain that leads directly to Taoyuan Village. (This path is very good and avoids some misleading mountain road signs that previously misled players.)
Make it easier to explore some details of Changshan.
I fixed some abnormal shadows in Taoyuan Village along the way.
0. The probability of encountering enemies in Yangzhou Cave has been reduced from 30 steps to 60 steps, which was a bit too frequent before
After the Battle of Guns and Swords, the original text of Wang Yue's sword Zhan Lu was handed over to Tong Yuan as a token, and an explanation was added that Wang Yue considered himself a failure. To avoid making players feel like there are any swords or other items left for Zhao Yun, which could lead to them having to rummage through boxes and cabinets.
(The master has already given the inherited gun, there are no swords left to give.)
2. Reduce the price of the props/fortune telling items sold by General Li on Changshan, making it as easy as possible to purchase them, as they cannot be accessed after descending the mountain. And the sale of these two destiny signs has been increased in the treasure shop in Jizhou
(The judgment condition is that if you do not possess the Hidden Jade in the Stone, you can purchase these two destiny signs and Spring and Autumn formulas again)
3. Send the Qianyuan Treasure Mirror from the Tree of the Underworld to increase judgment. If already owned, it will no longer be given as a gift. (To avoid two strange treasures appearing)
(Try to minimize some information that may be misunderstood by players)
4. A monster that can eliminate snake venom has been added in Chengdu. If players encounter a flashing red light on the screen, they can go to eliminate it (the Dragon Slayer Platform is also equipped with this function, which can be found in "Fix Abnormalities")
Old players may encounter this problem in Chapter 6, Yangzhou Cave, or Chapter 8, Fushui City,
It is still probabilistic in nature, and the problem can only be triggered if the character dies after being poisoned and does not resurrect during combat.
5. Now the screen will not flash red light. Simply delete the source code. Even if you accidentally trigger poisoning, there will only be bleeding, but the screen will no longer flash when walking. (You may not even notice)
6. Fixed the issue where the malevolent energy sometimes does not disappear after being exchanged, and also fixed the problem of the description of 'evil defeat' being a universal issue along the way
7. Fixed the issue with two pills
8. Fixed the issue where the Zhan Gang Sword could not be stacked.
9. Fixed the issue where players couldn't buy mushrooms and chives in the later stages, and added the sale of these two vegetables in Fushui, Yizhou, Chengdu, and Jianye, Yangzhou
10. Fixed the issue of eight golden lock arrays being unable to break and exit in certain special circumstances. It has now been completely repaired.
11. Fixed a traffic issue in a cave in Changsha that would cause players to walk to white areas, making it difficult to find the location of the crossbow.
After Chapter 2, most weapon stores have added the sale of Fire Refining Stones, which in some cases can be opened faster than in the Qianyuan Treasure Mirror. If you forget that the Qianyuan Treasure Mirror can be purchased, you can still buy it normally.
13. Fixed the issue where the sharp cut of the flying swallow in the training tower would cause bleeding. (Finally found the problem, it turned out to be the flashing red light on the screen caused by Feiyan killing someone)
14. Fixed and planted an orange tree
15. Fixed the issue in Chapter 6 where players of the Five Elements Illusion could get stuck at the door if they came out directly from the illusion without teleportation
16. Fixed the issue of Zhang Ning's seller model in some treasure stores.
17. Fixed the issue of incorrect description of the Royal Spirit Pill
18. Slightly increased the damage of Xiahou Lan's martial arts Mingzheng Dian Xing.

notes.title: [0413 Update] Fix game crash issue, connect achievements
notes.notes:
Slow startup, remember to turn off the shader

Fixed some translation issues



[Main Repair]
1.Fixed the issue of some games crashing after accessing achievements
We have tested both traditional and simplified Chinese users and have not found any new issues. You can rest assured to update and have a pleasant game.

2.The item drop rate of the three difficulty levels in the game are now consistent, and the high difficulty level will only earn some additional money and experience


[Bug fix]
1. Fixed the issue where Luo Fu couldn't join the team if you killed the enemy at lightning speed while cutting the river to save Adou
2. Fixed the issue of being unable to take Strong Muscle Pill and Healthy Bone Pill
3. The 20th enemy has been deleted and does not exist in the game
4. Deleted enemy number 69
[Content Adjustment]
1. Qiulong set, now it can trigger all the affix effects of armor (but it is not recommended to brush it, one is basically enough)
2. Increased the drop rate of the Xuanming Shield and the First Emperor's War Talisman (the drop rate is very mystical, and simple quick brushing may be a good choice, but it may not necessarily be able to drop them if it is difficult to persist)
3. Fate: 2% of the Ten Evil Defeat, the maximum loss of troops decreases to 1%
4. Some powerful bosses increase resistance to dizziness, which once made them unable to fight back.
At present, the feedback shows that this version is generally quite simple, and some equipment iterations are also okay,
If anyone has any ideas or suggestions, they can also raise them in the discussion forum, and I will go and read them.
There's no big problem, I'll focus on developing the content for the second week.

notes.title: Encountered game crash after update, please delete the game's files in【lib】
notes.notes:
[Important] If you encounter a crash issue after an achievement update, please delete the [files in lib] in the game folder. It will bypass the achievement judgment and you can play normally. I have been working on resolving this issue for the past two days. Currently, the achievement judgment of some models that are not compatible with the 0.94 version of nwjs is being tested using 0.92. Sorry. If there are any updates in the future, we will notify everyone quickly. 


This update does not have two objectives, mainly achievement fixes and some content optimizations. (This update will focus on the second week's schedule with full effort)


【 Slow game startup, remember to turn off shaders in Steam settings 】

Fixed a large number of translation errors. Thank you very much here：BloodyPork


Some minor optimizations:
1. Fixed the achievement issue. Now, if you replay, you can trigger achievements, and if you are playing, you can also trigger future achievements. I suggest completing the level normally and coming back to make up for achievements if you are interested.
2. The level restrictions in Chapter 4 have been completely eliminated and finally found (the problem lies with Bai Ma, which has been cancelled)
3. Now the menu pointer (that little hand) can be turned off by players themselves in the settings (I have increased the brightness of the default blue light selection, hoping that if you turn off the pointer, you can also see the selected state). Please choose to turn it off or on by yourself.
L ü Bu in the encyclopedia and the mouse in Chapter 4 can be seen, and the mouse has reduced its speed, making it easy to catch now.
5. Optimized the old man in Taoyuan Village. If you save the Ma siblings first, will he keep saying he wants to leave. Now he doesn't know how to do it anymore. Whenever you come to find him, you can complete his side quests
The old tree in Taoyuan Village will receive three old branches
7. You can also submit Liu Qi's request for the General Seal after he is cured, and now every taste of Zhou Li Ba Zhen will not be missed.
8. You can enter from Youzhou East, so you can enter there. The soldiers will not say that they cannot pass without General Gongsun's command. (Although it was possible to take a detour before)
9. The top-level game speed has been improved, and he will now quickly play against you without delaying


[Numerical changes]
The bonus of troops attached to everyone's attack now will be affected by the strength value, which will result in lower damage for small soldiers or enemies with lower strength, but higher damage for enemies with higher strength. Overall, the damage of enemies in the early stage will be lower, while the damage of powerful generals will be higher.
(Zhao Yun's damage slightly decreased when he was a child, but as he grew, his damage began to increase, which is more in line with the overall feeling. He avoids using 120 force to hit me with 2000 health and using 240 force to hit me with 2200 health.)
Feiyan's martial arts skills have been enhanced by her own agility, which affects her military strength.
Regarding the Ten Evil Defeat, it may be adjusted in the future as it is a bit too strong and makes the monsters appear weak.

Regarding Flashback
Recently, I have received feedback from several players that the crashes are mainly caused by rapid and continuous mouse clicks, as well as double clicks (which is also quite strange). I have not been able to troubleshoot the issue, so I can only suggest that if encountering crashes, it is better to use the keyboard as much as possible,
If you encounter crashes, you can give me feedback by providing information such as whether the computer is old or particularly good, how the configuration is, and how the graphics are integrated. Thank you very much. I am currently investigating the issue.
【 About Formation 】
Although the formation appears to disappear after reading the file, it is actually still there because the archive cannot remember its converted coordinates. Therefore, when you enter battle after reading the file, your formation exists and is not usable (referring to the one you used last time), which is not a bug.

Hide and Branch Optimization
Xu Rongchu optimized the plot again and made branches:
1： If you save Gong Sundu now and give him a letter, the letter will no longer be burned by you, and there will be no more hints of Liaodong plot freezing. Moreover, Gong Sundu can be seen again in Xuantu County in the east of Youzhou in Chapter 4.
He will say that he has understood what happened back then, no longer blames you, and there will be no further spoilers in the future.
2： If you don't rescue Gong Sundu, it will show that the Liaodong plot has been frozen, but you can still see Gong Sundu in Chapter 4. He will be rescued by others, but his legs will be broken. He will send the remaining Xuantu army to fight against you,
To avenge one's brothers.
(This branch has been thinking for a long time, and it should indeed be developed. This will also give the plot characters their own stories, and there should be changes in the weekly objectives, rather than telling everyone to wait until the next one.)

9. Aning's plot optimization:
One Now if you listen to Feiyan and let her go, Anning will give Feiyan a life and death talisman, a prop item.
II If you listen to Yunlu's words and kill her, Anning will drop a Huangtian Yanming Talisman, a prop item.
(I made some branches.)
10. After the Long Version War, a hidden branch was created (which will disappear as the plot progresses)
11. Some maps have added exploration treasure chests, hoping to give players who enjoy exploring some surprises when discovering treasure chests, instead of walking to a place and discovering nothing.
12. Yangzhou has added two new branching storylines to prevent players from discovering that they can only follow the main storyline when they arrive in Yangzhou. (It will disappear as the plot progresses, to avoid too much content existing along the main line, and even losing the feeling of free exploration on the necessary path)
A new monster cave has been added to Nanping Mountain to better illustrate why we are being prevented from borrowing wind.
3. Fixed the issue in Chengdu where the first time I went to a hotel to purchase a menu was from Yizhou. Now, the cuisine from the six major states is appearing normally.


【 Difficulty Adjustment 】
1. Now there is a guaranteed minimum of 5 challenge points for both normal and simple difficulty levels (the challenge points will completely overflow in the later stages, and many players may not have opened the challenge point store by the eighth chapter, so don't worry, focus on playing comfortably on your own)
4. Try to minimize the reward gap between ordinary and difficult difficulty levels, and no further changes will be made in the future. However, some monster mechanisms may be boring, and more interesting monsters may be added in the future.
[Detail optimization]
1. Newly added heavy forged stones with red weapons
When Yun Lu and Ma Chao joined the team, they no longer wore the Strategy Theory series, which was of little use. Yun Lu changed to Lie Nv Zhuan Ma Chao changed to Sit and Forget Theory.
The book 'sitting and forgetting' theory has increased the speed of action from 5 to 10, which should be somewhat useful in the early stages.
3. Yunlu is now immune to the suppressive effect of Ma Chao's destiny
4. Strengthen the protective smoke to 255 steps without encountering enemies.
5. Xiangyang Weapon Store increases sales of green antique bronze guns. Yuyang County in Youzhou increases sales of antique bronze guns and tin guns. Beiping City Armor Store increases sales of bronze shields. Gongsun Daying increased the sales of antique bronze guns and tin guns.
Suanzao Daying has increased the sales of antique bronze guns and tin guns. The Fushuicheng Treasure Store has increased the sale of fox fur coats (players who enjoy using hidden weapons can now purchase related crafting materials at various stages)
6. Fixed an air wall outside Chengdu and repaired an air wall outside Ganlu Temple in Yangzhou
7. Fixed the issue of Liu Bei lingering in Eastern Wu after getting married.
8. The Poison Scorpion in Yangzhou Cave will no longer poison players (this once caused a bug where if someone on our side dies from poisoning, the screen will continue to flash red light. If you encounter it, you need to go to Yangzhou Cave and be bitten by the Poison Scorpion once. If you survive, you will return to normal and use poison to fight poison)
Some enemies in Yizhou also have poisoning effects, and now their accompanying poisoning effects have been removed.
After the Battle of Immortals, your Zhao Yun will unlock the door. Click to enter the Trial Tower in Chengdu and it will also be unlocked. (Previously, Zhao Yun was locked and unable to change his position, which affected the effectiveness of the formation.)
10. Ganlu Temple has added an automatic transmission
11. I saw Liu Bei in Xichuan and added an automatic transmission.
12. After conquering the lower discrimination, an automatic mode has been added.
13. In the Battle of Huangzhong in Hanzhong, adjustments were made and the counterattack mechanism was cancelled (which had previously led to a probability of counterattacking to Feiyan, who triggered a counterattack and reported an error). Now, he will randomly strike one person at Huashan every round.
14. Adding Kong Ming to the team will have a set of equipment on him, which means he will have more basic skills.
15. Added a teleportation point from Nanjun to Xiangyang, currently in service, trial operation (when you first complete Nanjun, Nanjun will open the teleportation point to Xiangyang City. At this time, you can also teleport back through Xiangyang)
These two points are often used.
16. The issue with the sunset bow has been identified. If there is a suffix, the blood sucking effect of the sunset bow will become ineffective and cannot be fixed temporarily. I don't know why it was triggered.

Some drop optimizations
Chapter 2: Zhang Baoling's Treasure Scarf is bound to fall off.
2. The king snake in the snake cave has been changed to a must fall phantom fossil
3. It's still a bit difficult to drop three rhino horns at the same time.
4. The ticket for the Phantom Void World has been increased from 3 to 5 (which is the instance of the Orange Weapon)
5. Defeating Liu Guanzhang will earn Guan Yu's drop in the "Spring and Autumn Valley Liang Biography", which can synthesize Spring and Autumn in advance and encourage players to win against Liu Guanzhang. If you can't win the battle, just end the second chapter and purchase the "Spring and Autumn Valley Liang Biography" in the store
7. Slightly increased the probability of two drops in the Hundred War Box.
8. Increased the probability of dropping the First Emperor's talisman
8. Xu Rong has added the drop of the mount thief Li.


[Bug fix]
0. Fixed the issue in Chengdu where the first time I went to a hotel to purchase a menu was from Yizhou. Now, the cuisine from the six major states is appearing normally.
1. Fixed a message that kept reminding people to find Feiyan at Bowangpo
2. Lu Bu can appear in the encyclopedia and will prompt players what he has dropped.
3. The chubby mouse in Chapter 4 will now be hit by players and increase the value of gold. The selling value of gold is 2000-5000
